article.headline: New Orleans takes on Sacramento, seeks to stop 4-game skid
article.description: Sacramento Kings (0-4, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (0-4, 14th in the Western Conference)
article.title: New Orleans takes on Sacramento, seeks to stop 4-game skid
article.linkText: New Orleans takes on Sacramento, seeks to stop 4-game skid
article.story: Sacramento Kings (0-4, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (0-4, 14th in the Western Conference) New Orleans; Thursday, 8 p.m. EDT LINE: Pelicans -5.5; over/under is 237.5 BOTTOM LINE: New Orleans enters the matchup with Sacramento as losers of four straight games. New Orleans finished 26-56 overall, 17-34 in Western Conference games and 17-24 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Pelicans averaged 115.5 points per game while allowing opponents to score 120.0 last season. Sacramento finished 22-60 overall and 14-38 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Kings averaged 16.4 points off of turnovers, 14.8 second-chance points and 37.9 bench points last season. INJURIES: Pelicans: Yves Missi: day to day (knee), Jordan Poole: day to day (ankle). Kings: Ben Simmons: out for season (achilles), Keegan Murray: out (ankle), Dylan Cardwell: out (calf), Maxime Raynaud: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
